description:
Configure Screaming Frog SEO Spider for a mobile-first audit of https://books.toscrape.com/. 

STEPS:
1. Change the User-Agent to 'Googlebot Smartphone' (Configuration > User-Agent).
2. Configure Custom Extraction to capture the viewport meta tag (Configuration > Custom > Extraction). Use CSS Path: `meta[name="viewport"]` and extract the 'content' Attribute.
3. Crawl https://books.toscrape.com/ (wait for at least 50 pages).
4. Export the 'Internal > HTML' tab data to ~/Documents/SEO/exports/mobile_internal_html.csv.
5. Export the 'Custom Extraction' tab data to ~/Documents/SEO/exports/mobile_custom_extraction.csv.
6. Write a brief report to ~/Documents/SEO/reports/mobile_readiness_report.txt confirming the user-agent used, the number of pages crawled, and whether viewport tags were found.

Note: You must perform the configuration changes manually.
